description: S51 T3 (TM4): triage.health takes exactly the empty object and answers the one blueprint setting — key, effective NAME, state (ok | missing | invalid | unverifiable), and the analyzer's counts beside the verdict they decided. The states themselves are pinned daemon-side (they need settings and blueprint rows); this fixture pins the shape and the no-params law. A read, never a gate: a green line and a refused attempt honestly coexist one second apart.
